headline: Firmware that installs itself
items: Firmware Update now installs. Put a board into bootloader mode, or let the app restart the connected device into it, and Console writes the matching firmware and confirms the device came back running it.
Console ships the firmware it expects. The RP2040 and RP2350 images are bundled, so the app and the device can no longer drift apart.
A banner appears if a connected device is running a different firmware version, with a one-click update. It stays out of the way when the versions agree.
Version numbers are now plain point releases. Beta suffixes are gone, because a device can only report three numbers and two builds sharing a version cannot be told apart.
